content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Divisional Accounts Officer Recruitment 2026 - 12 Posts
content_sections.text: Kerala PSC has advertised 12 Divisional Accounts Officer (By Transfer) vacancies in Kerala State Electricity Board Limited under Category No. 176/2026. Important: This is an in-service quota recruitment exclusively for eligible departmental employees of KSEB Limited. It is not an open recruitment for all graduates or applicants from outside the organization. The notification provides for a competitive and qualifying examination and requires applicants to upload the prescribed service certificate in their Kerala PSC profile and produce the original during verification.

content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Field Supervisor Recruitment 2026 - 5 Posts
content_sections.text: The State Farming Corporation of Kerala Limited has announced five Field Supervisor Grade II vacancies under Category No. 181/2026. Usual age relaxation is available for eligible reserved-category candidates according to the notification.

content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC LD Clerk Recruitment 2026 - 3 Posts
content_sections.text: Travancore Sugars & Chemicals Limited has released Category No. 182/2026 for recruitment to three Lower Division Clerk posts . The DCA qualification must be obtained from an institution approved by the Central or State Government, or candidates must possess an accepted equivalent qualification.

content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Motor Vehicles Department has announced three Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector vacancies under Category No. 184/2026. This is a special recruitment exclusively for Scheduled Tribe candidates . Applicants must also satisfy the prescribed physical and medical conditions. The notification states that differently abled candidates are not eligible for this recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Medical Education Department has announced two Assistant Professor in Pharmacology vacancies under separate NCA categories. Applicants must possess MD/DNB in Pharmacology or M.Sc. Medical Pharmacology with Ph.D. in Medical Pharmacology, together with the prescribed Senior Resident or accepted equivalent professional experience. The notified age limit is 22–50 years , and the scale of pay is as per UGC norms.

content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process depends on the advertised post and the applicable Kerala PSC recruitment rules. The Commission may use written examinations, OMR tests, online examinations, practical tests, driving proficiency tests, physical tests, interviews and certificate verification, according to the individual notifications. Important: A single common examination pattern or selection process does not apply to all 18 categories. Applicants should check the relevant notification and subsequent examination programme.

content_sections.heading: Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible applicants must complete One Time Registration before applying for the relevant category. Official Website: www.keralapsc.gov.in Kerala PSC Thulasi Login: Kerala PSC Candidate Profile Application Last Date: 16 December 2026. Closing Time: 12 Midnight. Applicants must submit separate applications for each category for which they meet the eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Kerala PSC Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the Kerala PSC official website at www.keralapsc.gov.in . Open the One Time Registration or Thulasi Login section. New candidates must complete the required One Time Registration process. Existing registered candidates can log in using their User ID and password. Update personal, educational and contact information in the profile. Check that the required photograph, identity and qualification details are correctly entered. Open the Notification section. Find the relevant category number between 175/2026 and 192/2026. Download and read the complete notification. Confirm educational qualification, age limit, experience and reservation eligibility. Click the Apply Now option for the selected category. Complete the required declaration and application details. Upload any mandatory supporting certificates, such as an in-service certificate where applicable. Review the application carefully before final submission. Submit the application before 16 December 2026, midnight . Check the application status in the candidate profile. Save or print the submitted application details for reference. Monitor the Kerala PSC profile for examination confirmation, admission tickets and selection updates. Important: Candidates applying for NCA, special recruitment or by-transfer vacancies must ensure that they belong to the exact notified eligible group. Incorrect category claims can lead to rejection.
